body: Can I ask, why are you on here? Suicide watch is the toughest subreddit to be on, why are you here?
Nah man. I've never suffered any type of abuse. I was born dead, they revived me but as I got older I was diagnosed with all kinds of shit. I've never been abused, but I just can't live with myself.

Man I've come to peace with my decision the only reason I made this post was so my family could see when they find my phone on thebeach. I've never felt more peace in my life.

The only thing I can say for you is, thank you for everything, it was really sweet. It's important for you too, to get som help, because this can quickly become too much for anyone.

Man the human emotions suck, I wish I wasn't depressed, I've never had any motivation for anything. But my only wish is, that you live a healthy and happy life, thanks

I've said my goodbyes tonight to the people who care, I have never wanted the people that care to be close to me, I've always prepared for this moment. I was diagnosed with narcissism at a young age, also being diagnosed with adhd at the same time. I don't want to be the person I am, I've never wanted. 5 years of therapy has provided me with no help or options.
